name: Villasbuenas de Gata (Spain)
description: Square white flag with a green rectangle at the centre bearing the crowned municipal arms of Villasbuenas de Gata (a castle on blue between crosses of Alcántara).
history: Municipal flag of Villasbuenas de Gata; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villasbuenas de Gata arms — castle between crosses of Alcántara
